title: Video ad script template: hook, proof, offer and shots
seoTitle: Video ad script template, with a shot list
description: A fill-in video ad script template: hook in the first seconds, problem, proof, offer and call to action. Plus a shot list, two prompts and a real example.
lede: A good video ad script has five parts: a hook in the first few seconds, the problem, proof, the offer and one call to action. This guide gives you a fill-in template, a shot list, two prompts that write from customer words and a worked example.
